description: Six VCAs with adjustable response curves, cascading into one mix

params.text: Bends that channel's response curve, exponential counter-clockwise, straight at noon and logarithmic clockwise
Sets that channel's output level after its VCA, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: The signal that channel's VCA passes
Sets that channel's gain, 0-10V from silence to full; with nothing patched the channel runs at full gain

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its VCA and level knob, which takes it out of the mix; the sixth channel's jack carries the mix instead and always includes its own channel

notes: with the module bypassed each input is passed straight to the output on its own row
menu: Final row is mix — turned off, it stops the cascade, so every channel's jack carries only its own signal; it is on by default
